type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (r : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ),
  0 < r (Fin.last n) →
    0 < n →
      ∀ {lam : ℝ},
        2 * √↑(n + 1) < lam →
          (∀ {t : ℝ},
              0 < t →
                ↑{d ∈ Roth.box (r ∘ Fin.castSucc) | Roth.weight (r ∘ Fin.castSucc) d ≤ (↑n - t) / 2}.card ≤
                  2 * √↑n / t * ∏ j, (↑((r ∘ Fin.castSucc) j) + 1)) →
            ↑{d ∈ Roth.box r | Roth.weight r d ≤ (↑(n + 1) - lam) / 2}.card ≤ 2 * √↑(n + 1) / lam * ∏ j, (↑(r j) + 1)
